name: Pokédex Plate
description: Pokémon packed onto one printed page like a natural-history specimen sheet, each as large as the page allows, number and name beneath. A generation, a type, a random sheet each day or your list, from PokeAPI. Pixel sprites, official artwork or AI paintings in eight styles.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Which Pokémon
cell_options.help: A generation or a type picks from that group; Random is a different sheet of the whole National Pokédex every day; Your list is a team or favourites you type in.

choices.label: Random, a new sheet each day

cell_options.name: list
cell_options.label: Pokémon
cell_options.default:
Pikachu
Charizard
Gengar
Snorlax
Lapras
Eevee
cell_options.help: Names or National Pokédex numbers, one per line or separated by commas, up to 24. Mr. Mime, Farfetch'd and Nidoran♀ are fine as typed. Anything PokeAPI does not know is skipped and named at the foot of the plate.

cell_options.name: count
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Pokémon on the plate. The more there are, the smaller each is.

cell_options.name: order
cell_options.label: Pick
cell_options.help: Which of the group make the plate. Random daily changes once a day and stays the same all day, so a battery panel is not woken for nothing. Largest first takes the tallest of the group.

choices.label: Random, a new pick each day

cell_options.name: pictures
cell_options.label: Pictures
cell_options.help: Pixel sprites are the 96 px game sprites drawn at whole-number scales, crisp on e-paper. Official artwork is the large painted artwork. AI paintings repaint each Pokémon once from its official artwork in the style below, at about US$0.04 each with Nano Banana; the artwork shows until the painting lands. Needs a fal.ai key in this widget's settings or a key under Settings, Generative AI.

cell_options.name: style
cell_options.label: Style
cell_options.help: Each style is painted once per Pokémon and kept. Sumi-e and the line drawing are black ink only, the ones for a black and white panel.

cell_options.name: sizing
cell_options.label: Sizes
cell_options.help: About the same size gives every picture about the same room (sprites keep one pixel scale, as the games draw them). By real height scales each by its Pokédex height, so Wailord dwarfs Joltik; the smallest is held to a quarter of the tallest so it stays visible.

cell_options.name: labels
cell_options.label: Captions
cell_options.help: The number and the name on the first line, the types and the height on a second. Nothing ticked leaves the captions off. Crowded small cells keep the first line only.

cell_options.name: packing
cell_options.label: Packing
cell_options.help: Balanced packs from the middle out and grows each picture into the room left. Spiral makes a round cluster; Voids spreads the large ones over the page and fills the gaps with the small ones.

cell_options.name: names
cell_options.label: Names in
cell_options.help: The language of the Pokémon names, from PokeAPI. Titles and types stay in English.

cell_options.name: paper
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: The page colour on a colour panel. Greyscale and black and white panels always print on white.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: What the panel can show. Sprites snap to the panel's own greys, or on black and white are thresholded to clean black line art; artwork and paintings are converted and contrast-stretched.

cell_options.name: model
cell_options.label: Model
cell_options.help: All on fal.ai, all painting from the official artwork. Nano Banana is faithful and cheap; Nano Banana Pro follows an unusual style better; FLUX.1 Kontext Pro holds a style most strongly; GPT Image 2 is a good likeness; Seedream 4 is the budget one. A painting made with one model is kept when you switch to another.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank names the generation, the type, or the day.

cell_options.name: credits
cell_options.label: Credits
cell_options.help: The PokeAPI credit and the trademark notice at the foot of the plate, and the model behind any AI paintings.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widget can repaint each Pokémon from its official artwork, at about US$0.04 a painting, once per Pokémon and style. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run. Without one the widget shows sprites or artwork.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices (US$2 is about fifty Nano Banana paintings). 0 is no limit. Paintings are kept, so a Pokémon in a style only costs once.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50). A panel's own render starts what its page needs, within the daily budget.
